design: Physical pg_basebackup with SHA256 backup manifest, streamed base WAL and native pg_verifybackup.
Force and archive a post-base WAL segment containing a named restore point.
Source stopped before restoring a separate data root; matching system identifier is required for physical backup.
Restore pauses at named target; two earlier records visible and one deliberately later acknowledged row excluded.
Full source-after-target JSON is retained; latest source physical cluster custody and zero-loss policy are not claimed.
Second independent base copy lacks required target WAL; bounded terminal failure and missing-WAL evidence required.
Original basebackup and archived WAL file bytes retained in tar.gz with per-file SHA256 inventories.
